headline: Automakers Back US Rollback of Fuel Economy Rules
summary: Major automakers are supporting the United States rollbacks on federal fuel economy standards.
why: Changes to Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE) standards directly impact compliance costs, capital expenditure plans, and vehicle design strategies for major automotive manufacturers.

impacts.name: Automotive Sector
impacts.why: Rolling back fuel economy rules alters regulatory compliance costs for car manufacturers.
